notice: Producer research decision only. Independent review and owner adoption remain separate.
rationale: Executive Order 12553 (signed 1986-02-25; 51 FR 7237) orders that the listed Executive Orders, and any amendments to them, are revoked; the held Federal Register text of its table prints the line '11563 Amending Selective Service regulations' (and the same table lists 11586 and 11606). The Office of the Federal Register notes on both orders ('Revoked by: EO 12553, February 25, 1986') agree. The order is a single restatement of section 1631.7 of the Selective Service Regulations with no savings clause, and no held later order revives it, so it was not in force on 2026-10-14. The first end is not decided here: 1986-02-25 is the formal revocation date and an earlier end by expiry of the induction authority is not excluded by held sources.
